messages:
james: Drafting a compact PRD for the on-prem control-plane handover and customer-managed networking acceptance criteria. Need engineering + infra + product to sign off before we finalize rollout plan.

slee: thanks — can you drop the checklist here? I want to map to the workstream backlog. :memo: 

james: short checklist below (first pass). will iterate with owners.
```
PRD: On-prem Control Plane Handover - acceptance checklist (v0.1)
- Networking: customer-provided BGP/Static routes documented, egress IPs allocated, DNS delegation verified
- Security: TLS termination location, KMS/HSM integration validated, service account auth + scoped keys
- Observability: access to logs (read-only pipeline), traces, latency histogram sanity checks
- Deployability: airgap package install steps, k8s version compatibility, node sizing guide
- Failover: fallback to hosted model variants on detected network failure
- Tests: preflight smoke, multitenant isolation test, load ramp to 2x baseline
- Rollout: canary to single customer, 24h observation window, rollback criteria
```

anya: this is good. couple of edge cases to call out:
- customer NAT changing mid-rollout (source IP drift)
- partial firewall rules that block websocket/streaming ports only
- split-horizon DNS at customer side causing inconsistent model downloads
we should add acceptance steps for these.

priya: for rollout, propose: 1) preflight runbook + automated checks; 2) staged canary (non-prod -> dev -> prod-cust); 3) fail-open policy to hosted API if network degraded beyond threshold. Who owns the preflight automation?

james: @slee owns preflight automation. I'll own rollout orchestration and the PRD doc. priya — can you add product acceptance sign-off criteria?

slee: will add automation tasks to sprint board. preflight items I plan to include:
- `curl` to control-plane endpoint over customer path, expect 200 + proto-version header
- TLS cert chain verification + OCSP stapling check
- KV cache priming test (upload small model artifact, confirm checksum)
- streaming handshake test (open ws, send single token, ensure keepalive)

priya: acceptance sign-off (proposed):
- Security: 3rd-party pen-test passed OR customer-supplied sign-off
- Latency: p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 500ms on baseline traffic for first 24h
- Errors: <0.5% 5xx across control-plane APIs during observation window
- Observability: logs accessible, retention configured per customer tier
- Support: runbook + oncall roster confirmed

net-rtm: two networking notes: 1) some customers will only allow outbound TLS to few IPs — we need to provide static egress IP ranges and an IP rotation schedule. 2) for BGP handoffs, we must document AS-path requirements and community tags.

james: noted. add to PRD appendix -> `networking_constraints.md`. Also, we need to decide whether to support customer-managed DNS for model artifact downloads or force our-internal CDN (for integrity). pros/cons?

anya: customer-managed DNS gives them control but increases complexity and split-horizon risks. internal CDN simplifies integrity & caching but may require their firewall to allow outbound to our CDN IPs. I'd prefer internal CDN by default and an opt-in for customer-managed DNS with explicit checklist.

priya: agree. Opt-in path must include integrity checks (signature verification) and a documented fallback to our CDN if artifact fetch fails. Add to acceptance: artifact sig verification pass.

james: OK. next up: testing matrix and who signs each row. I'll sketch owners: Networking: net-rtm, Security: priya, Observability: slee, Runtime & artifacts: anya, Rollout: james. 

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled infra maintenance 2041235000 — not expected to affect private deploy canaries but double-check maintenance windows with customers.

priya: good catch. we should not schedule canary during that window. add to rollout plan: check maintenance API before starting stage.

james: action items captured:
- slee: implement preflight automation (tasks + test harness)
- net-rtm: produce static egress IPs + BGP appendix
- anya: add edge-case tests for NAT drift, websocket-only firewall blocks, split-horizon DNS
- priya: finalize acceptance sign-off matrix and pen-test requirement language
- james: produce final PRD v0.2 and schedule review with infra + legal (for data access clauses)

slee: timeline estimate: preflight automation probe set ~2 sprints; smoke harness + runbook ~1 sprint after that.

james: thanks. let's reconvene Thu 09:30 PT for a quick triage. please drop any blockers here. :eyes: 

anya: one blocker — we need legal guidance on customer audit access to our metrics (read-only). I'll ping legal and loop you, james.

james: perfect. leaving TODOs in the PRD draft. will upload link once I push to /docs/private-deploy/prd_controlplane_handover.md

slee: acked. moving tasks to the private-deploy board.

net-rtm: will start writing the BGP appendix and post a draft here by EOD tomorrow.

priya: signing off on this thread for now, will add acceptance language and share review link.

james: thanks team. follow-ups in doc + Thu sync. :rocket:
